column1: # Estimated JLPT level (N5-N1) for each kanji, one per line: kanji <TAB> level.
# The JLPT has published no official kanji list since the 2010 move to
# N5-N1 (kanji-expansion-plan.md §3.3), so these are community estimates,
# and the app says so wherever it shows them.
# Source: Jonathan Waller's JLPT kanji lists, http://www.tanos.co.uk/jlpt/
# (Creative Commons Attribution), as compiled into the `jlpt_new` field of
# (MIT licence), downloaded 2026-09-28. Every kanji listed there is one this
# app teaches; the 172 jōyō kanji with no level are simply absent here.
# Read by tools/build_kanji_orders.py. Listed in the app's own school-grade
# teaching order, so a diff after a data refresh stays readable.
